body:
🌌 Mystravia: The World Beyond the Veil
Mystravia is a realm shrouded in mystery, where the line between reality and illusion grows thin. Its skies are forever painted in twilight — deep violet, dotted with eternal stars that never fade. This land is not only filled with ancient forests and forgotten ruins but also harbors long-lost magic and creatures of myth.

Beneath its mesmerizing beauty lies a buried truth: the fragments of an older world, torn apart by a war between ancient sorcerers. Now, five key regions — Vel’Naer (The Whispering Woods), Umbrelyn (The Shadowed Vale), Soltharion (The Aether Spire), Noctir (The Mistsea), and Zerundra (The Fractured Lands) — cling to a fragile balance.

Adventurers, mages, and relic hunters from all corners seek Mystravia’s truths… or its power. But every step forward leads them deeper into a realm that constantly shifts — where time can stop, and voices can vanish into silence.
